title: GridAR · 逐块生成与候选筛选 Teaser

description.zh: 把局部候选、保留与拒绝、最终生成效果组织成视觉链，让读者在看方法文字之前直观理解为何分配测试时计算。
description.en: A visual story of partial candidates, acceptance/rejection and completed outputs, communicating selective test-time compute without a dense diagram.

zh: 展示生成式搜索、验证器筛选或其他具有候选比较的算法。
en: Illustrating generation search, verifier selection or algorithms with candidate-based decisions.

zh: 局部图块与完整图之间具有形状对应；✅ / ❌ 的判定符号比大段文字更快传达差异；候选对照落在真实图像上。
en: Partial crops correspond to full outputs; selection marks rapidly communicate decisions; actual generated imagery grounds comparisons.

zh: Teaser 中的选择标志是论文叙事，不得直接当作我们的外部独立实验核验。
en: Selection annotations explain the authors' method; they are not independent replication evidence.
